text:
Riley: Quick UX bug from QA: when the toast appears while scrolling a long table with sticky header, the header gets pushed down and then overlaps the first row once the toast disappears. Seen on Chrome/Win and Safari/Mac. Screenshot: https://placeholder.img/sticky-header-overlap.png
Chen: repro. Root cause: toast is in normal flow and the sticky header uses top: 0 so when toast inserts space the header briefly shifts, then when toast disappears the header snaps back and z-index/stacking causes overlap.
Priya: Accessibility risk: keyboard users tabbing to a row near the top lose visual context because the sticky header animation misaligns with the focused cell. Also NVDA announced the row but focus visual was behind the header.
Riley: Proposal: move toast to a fixed UI layer and update sticky header to respect a dynamic offset variable (e.g., --ui-toast-height). That way header's top can be calc(var(--safe-top) + var(--ui-toast-height)) so it never overlaps content.
Owen: CSS prototype:
```css
:root { --ui-toast-height: 0px; }
.rw-toast { position: fixed; top: 12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 800; }
.table-header--sticky { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--safe-top, 0px) + var(--ui-toast-height)); z-index: 850; }
```
Chen: we'll need JS so when toast mounts we set document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ui-toast-height', toast.offsetHeight + 'px') and clear on unmount. Also animate changes so header transitions nicely.
Priya: important for a11y: setting a CSS offset is fine as long as focusable elements remain reachable. Ensure we don't rely on visual-only offsets to hide things from screen readers. Also keep aria-live=polite for toasts and do not move focus to them.
Riley: spacing token nit: table action groups are super dense in compact list view. Currently use --space-1 (4px). Request a new compact token --gap-compact (6px) for dense lists so we don't change global --space-1. Thoughts?
Owen: Agree on a component-scoped token. I'll add --gap-compact token and wire it in TableCompact variant. That keeps global spacing stable.
Chen: microcopy: some toasts read "Saved row" while others say "Saved". For inline row edits I'd prefer the targeted copy "Row saved" to help screen reader users who get a list of announcements. Let's add a short note in content-guidelines.
Priya: Focus visuals: in compact tables our icon-only actions get very tight focus rings. Propose we keep 2px focus ring but increase outline-offset to 4px for compact rows to avoid overlapping cell borders. Also ensure dark-mode variant uses --color-focus-inverse.
Riley: QA plan: 1) automated visual snapshot for a long-scroll table with toast triggered mid-scroll; assert header y-offset delta < 3px during animations, 2) keyboard e2e: trigger toast then tab to first cell and assert visible (getBoundingClientRect top > header bottom), 3) screen-reader smoke test.
Owen: dev plan: small PR to: move toasts to fixed layer + aria-live, add --gap-compact token and TableCompact style, add JS to set --ui-toast-height on mount/unmount, update copy to "Row saved" for inline edits, tweak focus offset for compact rows. Will include screenshots and a small snippet for the e2e.
Chen: minor concern: if other components set --ui-toast-height differently it could conflict. We should document this CSS var and make it a single source of truth in DESIGN_TOKENS.md so platform embeds can honor it.
Priya: also add note to component docs: floating interactive elements (menus, popovers) should portal to body so they aren't trapped under sticky headers or toasts.
Riley: design-bot 1: can you open a tracking PR for these changes?
design-bot: PR opened: redwood/design-system#957 "sticky-table: toast fixed layer + --ui-toast-height + compact gap token + focus tweaks" (assigned to Owen)
Owen: I'll land the PR with a small migration note and a short JS util so teams can reuse the toast-height setter. ETA: today afternoon.
Priya: I'll run NVDA and VoiceOver checks once PR is ready and validate focus behaviour.
Chen: I'll add the visual test and the small JS util to infra tests.
Riley: thanks all 60; please tag @platform-ux and @eng-runtime if you change token names. :thumbsup:
